title: Get in touch
description: A few quick questions so we can route your enquiry to the right person.
intro: Happy to help. I'll ask a few short questions, one at a time — it takes about three minutes. You can say "skip" to any of them, or "stop" to pause and come back later.
conduct: Be warm and brief. Ask one question at a time.
Never pressure the participant for a detail they would rather not give.
It is always fine for someone to skip a question or say they don't know.
scope_guard: If the participant raises something outside this form, acknowledge it in one sentence and steer gently back to the current question.

questions.prompt: What name should we use when we reply?
questions.sufficiency_criteria: Sufficient as soon as any name is given.

questions.prompt: What's the best email address to reach you on?
questions.guidance: An email address is enough; don't ask for a phone number.
questions.sufficiency_criteria: Sufficient when something that looks like an email address is given.

questions.guidance: A sentence or two is plenty. If it's very vague, ask once for a little more.
questions.sufficiency_criteria: Sufficient when the subject of the enquiry is identifiable.
